# netbox_l2vpn_termination (Data Source)

An L2VPN termination attaching an interface or VLAN to an L2VPN (vpn.l2vpntermination).

From the [official documentation](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/vpn/l2vpntermination/):

> A L2VPN termination is the attachment of an [L2VPN](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/vpn/l2vpn/) to an [interface](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/dcim/interface/) or [VLAN](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/ipam/vlan/). Note that the L2VPNs of the following types may have only two terminations assigned to them:
>
> * VPWS
> * EPL
> * EP-LAN
> * EP-TREE

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_l2vpn_termination" "test" {
  id = 123
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `assigned_object_id` (Number) Id of the terminating object (see assigned_object_type).
- `assigned_object_type` (String) Content type of the terminating object. Derived from device_interface_id, virtual_machine_interface_id or vlan_id when one of those is set; set it together with assigned_object_id otherwise. One assignment is required. One of: dcim.interface, virtualization.vminterface, ipam.vlan.
- `assigned_object_type_id` (Number) Id of the assigned object type.
- `created` (String)
- `custom_field_filters` (Map of String) Custom field values to match, by field name, e.g. { tier = "gold" }: each entry filters as cf_<field name> with the field's own filter logic, loose (case-insensitive substring) or exact.
- `device_id` (Number) Id of the device.
- `device_interface_id` (Number) Id of the terminating device interface (assigned_object_type dcim.interface). Conflicts with the other aliases and with setting the assigned_object_* pair directly.
- `device_name` (String) Name of the device.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `interface_name` (String) Name of the interface.
- `l2vpn_id` (Number) Id of the L2VPN.
- `l2vpn_slug` (String) Slug of the L2VPN.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `q` (String) Search term, matched against the fields NetBox searches for this object type.
- `region_id` (Number) Id of the region.
- `region_slug` (String) Slug of the region.
- `site_id` (Number) Id of the site.
- `site_slug` (String) Slug of the site.
- `tag_id` (Number) Id of a tag the object carries.
- `tag_slug` (String) Slug of a tag the object carries.
- `virtual_machine_id` (Number) Id of the virtual machine.
- `virtual_machine_interface_id` (Number) Id of the terminating virtual machine interface (assigned_object_type virtualization.vminterface). Conflicts with the other aliases and with setting the assigned_object_* pair directly.
- `virtual_machine_name` (String) Name of the virtual machine.
- `vlan_id` (Number) Id of the terminating VLAN (assigned_object_type ipam.vlan). Conflicts with the other aliases and with setting the assigned_object_* pair directly.
- `vlan_name` (String) Name of the VLAN.
- `vlan_vid` (Number) Id of the VLAN number (1-4094).
- `vminterface_name` (String) Name of the VM interface.

### Read-Only

- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. An object field holds the related object's id, e.g. "12", a multiobject field a JSON list of ids in any order, e.g. jsonencode([12, 13]). A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)
